title: Spreadsheet Reasoning Inspector
dek: Formuloom is a pipeline I built in Python for reviewing changes to financial models: it sorts a workbook's changed cells into final outputs, the values someone would report, and intermediates, the working steps. Rebuilt here on one small workbook, with rules voting on each cell.
summary: Rules vote on which spreadsheet values are final: balanced voting marks a scratch cell final, and a stricter gate finds neither real result.
